name: @stacknyu/pi-check
description: One shared, cached, speculative check runner per repo for every Pi session and worktree: Go, TypeScript/JavaScript and Python tests, type checks and linters run once per file content, pre-run while you edit, and throttled so parallel agents stop fighting
